title: Doctor and policy history bind evaluations to seals, authority to policy, and citations to canonical verification results
outcome: Doctor and policy history bind evaluations to seals, authority to policy, and citations to canonical verification results
acceptance: a re-frozen policy version whose acceptance_evaluation disagrees with its authority decision is refused by policy-history verification

a shared seal-to-evaluation validator (exists, same work and run, at or before the completion cut, all pass, derived vector equals the sealed vector) is unit-tested per relationship and a doctor test with a re-frozen forged seal reports completion_seal:<hash>:acceptance_evaluation_binding while legacy seals stay healthy
an observed citation is classified from the canonical VerificationEvidence and a corrupted verification_result projection column is refused as an invalid projection

completion.summary: One shared seal-to-evaluation validator (exists, names the sealed work and run, at or before the completion cut, all pass, derives the sealed vector) applied by completion before the write, by doctor (completion_seal:<hash>:acceptance_evaluation_binding), and by the provenance read; the policy loader compares authority.acceptance_evaluation with the policy so history, opening, and doctor refuse a re-frozen disagreeing version; observed citations are classified from the canonical VerificationEvidence and an inconsistent projection column refuses. Doctor now decodes set_acceptance_evaluation receipts (gap found by the fixtures' positive controls, logs/10). Negative fixtures re-freeze every hash so only the relationship is wrong. Gates recorded here for the whole correction changeset (logs/13, /14). RED logs/08 and /10, GREEN logs/11 and /12; docs doctor paragraph, R10, B36/B37/B40.
